name: powermods-swarm
description: Spawn, watch and steer a swarm of Claude Code agents from a side pane: live status and token use, approvals and questions, messaging, kill and auto-restart, saved rosters

allowBypass.title: Offer "Bypass all checks" for swarm agents
allowBypass.description: Off by default. When on, the spawn form also offers "Bypass all checks": a separate session starts with claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, and a teammate has every call approved that Claude Code would ask about. Each use asks you to confirm, naming the folder. Deny rules still apply

workersAcceptMessages.title: Workers accept the lead's messages without asking
workersAcceptMessages.description: Off by default, so separate-session workers keep Claude Code's own setting for messages from other sessions and may hold a message for your approval in their window. When on, each worker starts with crossSessionInbound set to accept (for that worker only, through --settings)
